pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: src/app/layout.tsx:20 RootLayout renders the product as an HTML document around V2Shell, and a search of src/app for electron, tauri, accessibility, globalShortcut, and clickThrough found no hits, so this shell never leaves the document runtime.

techniques.evidence: src/app/layout.tsx:20 No per-host capability to classify; the shell is a document root.
src/app/layout.tsx:20 No synthesized chord into a foreign application.
src/app/layout.tsx:20 No long-lived stream owned by a view or a native process.
src/app/layout.tsx:20 No always-on-top surface over another application.
src/app/layout.tsx:20 No structural query of a foreign application.
src/app/layout.tsx:20 No host grant vector; src/app has no permission identifier.
src/app/layout.tsx:20 No overlay that a point query could return.
src/app/layout.tsx:20 No reach for an unexported host entry point.
